summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine vesting of Performance Share Plan awards for CEO Pascal Soriot. No price/share is involved; shares were acquired for nil consideration. The filing does not announce any strategic event, merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation. It is purely a notification of share vesting under an existing equity plan and a director/PDMR shareholding disclosure. As a routine insider transaction, this does not meet the threshold for any special-situations category. The non-US filing maps to a US-equivalent beneficial ownership change report.
